About MegaMind Distributors

Building trust. Supplying quality. Supporting every project.

Winnie Ngugi

Megamind Distributors

WhatsApp us

At MegaMind Distributors, our vision is to become a trusted, go-to destination for quality hardware products and building materials. As we grow our brand, we are committed to making it easier for homeowners, fundis, contractors, and businesses to access the essential products they need to bring their projects to life.

As the CEO, I believe that building a strong business goes beyond supplying products. It is about earning our customers’ trust, understanding their needs, providing reliable service, and building lasting relationships. Our goal is to make sourcing building materials a smooth, convenient, and dependable experience for every customer we serve.

From everyday hardware essentials to materials for larger construction projects, MegaMind Distributors aims to be a reliable partner at every stage of the building journey. Through quality, professionalism, and a customer-first approach, we are working towards building a brand that people can confidently turn to whenever they need hardware products and building supplies.

We are more than a supplier; we are part of your building journey.

Winnie Ngugi, CEO

What we supply

Frequently asked questions

Where are you based?

Our main shop is in Nairobi. We open Monday to Saturday, 8am to 5pm.

Do you deliver?

Yes, we deliver countrywide. Call or WhatsApp 0732 056 812 to arrange delivery terms for your order.

How can I pay?

Pay by M-Pesa on 0732 056 812, the same number we use for WhatsApp. A bank account is coming soon.

How do I get a price?

Tap “Ask for price” on any product, or message us on WhatsApp. We reply with the current price and stock. For a full list, use the quotation page.

Do you sell in bulk?

Yes. We supply retail and bulk orders. Send your list for a bulk quotation.

Can you help me choose the right size?

Yes. Tell us what you are installing and we will advise on sizes and fittings.
